glosses: bite (act of biting) (verbal noun of укуси́ть (ukusítʹ) (nomen actionis instantiae))
bite, sting (verbal noun of укуси́ть (ukusítʹ) (nomen resultatis))

examples.en: Tom died from a scorpion sting.
You shouldn't scratch your mosquito bite.

examples.text: У меня комариные укусы по всей руке.
examples.en: I have mosquito bites all over my arm.
